recipes.topic: LibreOffice Flatpak file access & Word styling
recipes.lesson: Save `.docx` in `~/Documents/` (Flatpak cannot read `/tmp`); embed images/tables via `caelestia-desktop write-docx --image` or `office-paste --image`.
Reject MSN/privacy modals and DuckDuckGo SERP self-copies (`duckduckgo.com/?`); advance to real sites (`gsmarena`, `sammobile`, `9to5google`) or escalate to Round-2 `search_web`.
Use `caelestia-desktop yt-play` (skips header `--min-y 185` & checks `pactl list sink-inputs` `Corked: no`); never rely on `playerctl` for Firefox.
Launch installed apps (`kate`, `code`, `dolphin`, `vlc`, `okular`, `gwenview`, `kcalc`, `btop`) via `caelestia-desktop launch` & confirm open/closed via `hyprctl clients -j`.

recipes.topic: Guaranteed multi-image & YouTube capture for Word
recipes.lesson: Use `web-copy --image-count N` + keyword-filtered DDG `i.js` fallback and `yt-play --screenshot` + `write-docx --images` when multiple images are requested.

recipes.topic: Chained multi-hop search without SERP trap
recipes.lesson: For dependent A->B->C queries or multi-app tasks, skip curated Round-1 `web-copy` and chain `search_web` + `write-docx --images` directly in `run_single_fast`.

recipes.topic: Toggle Night Light without changing power mode
recipes.lesson: Use `caelestia shell modes setNightLight true 3500` directly (<0.1s) instead of switching into full `sleep` mode unless user asked for battery saver.

Avoid thin JS/SPA stub pages (<1200 chars); auto-enrich from hit #2, fetch keyword-verified artwork (>=360px), and translate Word docs to Vietnamese when prompt is Vietnamese even if chatLanguage=auto.

recipes.topic: Clean app window close & media stop
recipes.lesson: Use `caelestia-desktop stop-media --close-tab` and `caelestia-desktop close-app <target> [--force]` (kills exact GUI PID or `flatpak kill`, NEVER `pkill -f`); verify `hyprctl clients -j`.
Use `caelestia-desktop fetch-images "<query>" --count N --out /tmp/ai_img.jpg` (~2s) + `write-docx --images ...` instead of manual scraping loops.

recipes.topic: Hyprland workspace free-space guard before app launch
recipes.lesson: Always check workspace capacity via `caelestia-desktop ensure-workspace` or `caelestia-desktop launch <cmd>`; auto-switch to a new workspace if `>=2` tiled windows or `<820x480` room.
Batch `caelestia-telemetry`, `scxctl get`, `hyprctl clients -j`, `wpctl`, and `brightnessctl` into a single `run_command` call (<0.2s) instead of separate turns.

recipes.topic: YouTube search chip & Shorts skip rule
recipes.lesson: Scan YouTube results with min_y>=245 & title length>=18 chars to skip Shorts/chips; retry hits[1] cleanly before Round-2 fallback.
